_comment: Utanya RAG evaluation set (60 questions). FIELDS: id; question (PT); query_type (expected classification: current_state|specific_date|comparison|trend); category; seo_value (high|medium|low — whether this doubles as SEO content); needs_gold (true = answer NOT yet verified, YOU must fill must_contain from your source data before this question gives a valid signal); expected (human-review note / gold answer); must_contain (strings that MUST appear for a PASS); must_not_contain (strings whose presence is an automatic FAIL — hallucination markers). The harness ignores assertion-less questions as REVIEW. Questions grounded only in bulletins 2654, 2722, 2723, 2724, 2725, the ingested legislation, and documented market facts are fully verified; all others are flagged needs_gold.
